title: Root-tied reachability STOP ablations and branching-controlled Horn proof search
research_questions: Can root-tied reachability or removal of interior STOP reduce false stopping and exceed the first-legal baseline using unchanged AF-22 checkpoints?
Does a compact recurrent model add value over first-legal and randomized legal rules in a preregistered graph family with meaningful action branching and proof-length differences?

core_constraints.host_rule_legality: All applied rule transitions certified by host physical Horn premises, STOP always available
core_constraints.oracle_inference: disallowed except labeled shortest-proof upper control
core_constraints.proof_budget: minimum independent BFS proof length +1 legal firing on provable cases; two actions on unprovable cases
core_constraints.frozen_source: Keep AF-22 original protocol, models, failures, checkpoints, audit and evidence release unchanged
core_constraints.launch_rule: Source, structural cases, thresholds, assertions, and artifact handling committed before running any AF-23 heldout evaluation; formal experiment CI requires separate scoring commit after source-lock
core_constraints.failure_policy: Any eligible seed gate failure yields FAIL. Missing/invalid source-bound run yields INCONCLUSIVE, never silently excluded.
core_constraints.reporting: Report every seed, arm, heldout depth and fixed/oracle controls, with scored numerator/denominator and exact number of false accepted proofs
core_constraints.compute: Measure unique host states, neural forward calls, algorithmic latency/compute; do not claim same-cost inference from sharing weights or precomputing planning traces

track_A.name: STOP calibration on AF-22's original 416 cases with original frozen checkpoints
track_A.checkpoint_source: Exactly AF-22's original eight trained Torch checkpoints from source-pinned official CI #43788715688; strict SHA-256 and Torch/NumPy parity
track_A.root_tie: p(s') := p(root) for nonterminal nodes s' in a receding-horizon neighborhood; terminal goal values and cost remain exact zero; distance heads remain node-specific; root C_STOP unchanged
track_A.no_interior_stop: At non-root nonterminal successor nodes, ignore STOP in V1 and take min enabled one-step transitions or V0 at a depth limit; leave root STOP available and terminal goal at zero
track_A.combined: Apply root_tie and no_interior_stop simultaneously, independently pre-registered
metrics: false premature STOP on provable cases, including first decision
correct immediate STOP on unprovable cases
proof action optimality on provable starts

primary_gate.comparison: first-legal fixed (absolute and paired cases, per seed at both held_depth4/5)
primary_gate.depth_rule: both held depths must satisfy all criteria in same qualifying seed
primary_gate.eligibility: all eight source-verified AF22 frozen checkpoints; no re-selection

track_A.frozen_checkpoint_validation: Run/source-commit sha, original artifact digest, training receipt, checkpoint Torch/NumPy exact parity; lossless validation and audits before any rollout
track_A.analysis_only: Original AF22 per-episode ledgers may be used for static first-decision counterfactual checks labeled retrospective, never as full episode scores or new training data

track_B.name: Meaningful branching in fresh positive-Horn proof DAGs
track_B.grammar: 4 root facts, 4 tempting decoy first-step rules, 2 productive initial rules, decoy chains, and a depth-conditional productive chain of 3/4/5 minimal firings; all rule incidence and role marks public

test_splits.held_depth4: layouts 203-204, 96 cases per layout, 40 provable+56 unprovable each = 192
test_splits.held_depth5: layouts 205-206, same size and truth balance as depth 4 = 192

track_B.case_varying: Physical atom/rule slot permutations derived from split, layout and template ID; decoy wiring and presence/absence of critical root facts also vary

structural_gate.required: Every heldout positive case meets structural gate; if fail, stop before scored experiment and amend protocol by versioned preregistration

training.train_only_oracle_supervision: Exact shortest cost and optimal action allowed only on train split; evaluate heldout using host-legality and neural outputs

track_B.random_rule: Each random arm samples from currently legal rules without a STOP decision until goal or exhaustion; five registered deterministic independent PRNG streams and identical proof-action budgets

primary_gate.depth_rule: all gates at depth 4 and depth 5 in same qualified seed
primary_gate.eligibility: final trained model has finite 6036 weights, successful source and artifact checks, and >=0.65 train/dev rule success (eligibility must also be presented against fixed and random levels)

diagnostics: first STOP and correct STOP by truth

reproducibility.technical_preflight: Python standard library structural and host-oracle tests must pass before training
reproducibility.science_note: Track B is independent from Track A: using a harder gym never retroactively rescues AF-22's original FAIL.
